### libraries

```{r}
# library code will go here (will eventually be moved to and R-script)

# libraries we'll be using
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(Lahman) # specific data set for the app (baseball data)

data("LahmanData", package = "Lahman")
```

### ui

```{r}
# UI code is gonna go here for now (will eventually be moved to an R-script)

# ui/display code here
ui <- page_sidebar(
  
  # code for the title of the page
  title = "Baseball Data and Analytics — Courtesy of the Lahman Package",
  
  # sidebar code
  sidebar = sidebar(
    position = "right",
    
    # year selection first  
    selectInput(
      "year_choice",
      "Select a Year to View:",
      choices = sort(unique(Lahman::Teams$yearID), decreasing = TRUE)
    ),

    
    # team selection second (choices get updated from server)
    selectizeInput(
      "team_choice",
      "Choose a Team to View:",
      choices = NULL,
      options = list(placeholder = "Select a year first")
    ),

    # stat/metric (choices get updated from server)
    selectizeInput(
      "stat_choice",
      "Select Stat to View:",
      choices = NULL,
      options = list(placeholder = "Select a team first")
    )
  ),
  
  # main page / card code here
  card(
    card_header(uiOutput("card_title")),
    card_body(
      tableOutput("team_stats_tbl"),
      fluidRow(
        column(6, plotOutput("stat_plot_year", height = "320px")),
        column(6, plotOutput("stat_plot_prev", height = "320px"))
      )
    )
  )
)
```

### server

```{r}
# server code is gonna go here for now (will eventually be moved to an R-script)

# server/back end code for the app
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # ---------- helpers ----------
  year_int <- reactive({
    req(input$year_choice)
    yr <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(input$year_choice))
    req(!is.na(yr))
    yr
  })

  teams_year <- reactive({
    subset(Lahman::Teams, yearID == year_int())
  })

  team_row <- reactive({
    req(input$team_choice)
    df <- teams_year()
    row <- df[df$teamID == input$team_choice, , drop = FALSE]
    req(nrow(row) >= 1)
    row[1, , drop = FALSE]
  })

  ranked_dot_plot <- function(df, stat, year, selected_team) {
    validate(
      need(stat %in% names(df), "Selected stat isn't available for this year."),
      need(is.numeric(df[[stat]]), "Selected stat isn't numeric, can't plot.")
    )

    d <- df[, c("teamID", "name", stat)]
    names(d)[3] <- "value"

    d <- d[is.finite(d$value), , drop = FALSE]
    validate(need(nrow(d) > 1, "Not enough data to plot."))

    d <- d[order(d$value, decreasing = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
    d$rank <- seq_len(nrow(d))

    plot(
      x = d$value, y = d$rank,
      xlab = stat, ylab = "League Rank (1 = most)",
      main = paste0(year, " — ", stat),
      yaxt = "n"
    )
    axis(2, at = pretty(d$rank))
    abline(h = pretty(d$rank), lty = 3)

    idx <- which(d$teamID == selected_team)
    if (length(idx) == 1) {
      points(d$value[idx], d$rank[idx], pch = 19, cex = 1.4)
      text(d$value[idx], d$rank[idx], labels = d$teamID[idx], pos = 4)
    } else {
      mtext("Selected team not found this year", side = 3, line = 0.2, cex = 0.85)
    }
  }

  # ---------- sidebar inputs ----------
  observeEvent(year_int(), {
    df <- teams_year()

    # avoid duplicate teamIDs if present
    df <- df[!duplicated(df$teamID), , drop = FALSE]

    team_labels <- paste0(df$name, " (", df$teamID, ")")
    team_values <- df$teamID
    names(team_values) <- team_labels

    updateSelectizeInput(
      session,
      "team_choice",
      choices = team_values,
      selected = character(0),
      server = TRUE
    )

    updateSelectizeInput(
      session,
      "stat_choice",
      choices = character(0),
      selected = character(0),
      server = TRUE
    )
  })

  available_stats <- reactive({
    req(input$team_choice)
    row <- team_row()

    num_cols <- names(row)[vapply(row, is.numeric, logical(1))]
    setdiff(num_cols, c("yearID"))
  })

  observeEvent(input$team_choice, {
    stats <- available_stats()
    req(length(stats) > 0)

    default_stat <- if ("W" %in% stats) "W" else stats[1]

    updateSelectizeInput(
      session,
      "stat_choice",
      choices = stats,
      selected = default_stat,
      server = TRUE
    )
  })

  # ---------- card header ----------
  output$card_title <- renderUI({
    req(input$team_choice)
    stat_txt <- if (!is.null(input$stat_choice) && nzchar(input$stat_choice)) {
      paste0(" | Stat: ", input$stat_choice)
    } else {
      ""
    }
    paste0("Year: ", year_int(), " | Team: ", input$team_choice, stat_txt)
  })

  # ---------- core team stats ----------
  output$team_stats_tbl <- renderTable({
    row <- team_row()

    wanted <- c("W", "L", "R", "RA", "HR", "SB", "ERA")
    cols <- intersect(wanted, names(row))
    req(length(cols) > 0)

    data.frame(
      Stat  = cols,
      Value = vapply(cols, function(x) row[[x]][[1]], numeric(1)),
      row.names = NULL
    )
  }, striped = TRUE, bordered = TRUE, spacing = "s")

  # ---------- ranked dot plots ----------
  output$stat_plot_year <- renderPlot({
    req(input$team_choice, input$stat_choice)
    df <- teams_year()
    ranked_dot_plot(df, input$stat_choice, year_int(), input$team_choice)
  })

  output$stat_plot_prev <- renderPlot({
    req(input$team_choice, input$stat_choice)
    prev_year <- year_int() - 1

    df_prev <- subset(Lahman::Teams, yearID == prev_year)
    validate(need(nrow(df_prev) > 0, "No data available for prior year."))

    ranked_dot_plot(df_prev, input$stat_choice, prev_year, input$team_choice)
  })
}
```

### run app

```{r}
# code to run the app (will eventually be moved to an R-script)

# runs the app
shinyApp(ui = ui, server=server)
```
